## Windows compatibility
Displon supports Windows 10 and Windows 11 (x64). Changes that only work on Windows 11, or that break Windows 10, are not accepted.

- [ ] This change works on both Windows 10 and Windows 11
- [ ] It does not rely on a Windows 11-only API or behavior (or it has a working Windows 10 fallback)

Tested on:
- [ ] Windows 10 (x64)
- [ ] Windows 11 (x64)
